home.title: Qaemati demo restaurants
home.subtitle: Two sample menus, built to show what a restaurant’s own Qaemati menu looks like.
home.description: Pick a restaurant to open its live menu:

landing.metaTitle: Qaemati: digital QR menus for restaurants and cafes
landing.metaDescription: Put your restaurant's menu on your guests' phones in Arabic and English. They scan a QR code, browse and send their order to your WhatsApp. You edit it from your phone.

hero.title: Your menu, one scan away.
hero.text: Qaemati puts your restaurant's menu on your guests' phones, in Arabic and English. They scan a QR code, browse, and send their order to your WhatsApp. You edit prices and dishes from your own phone.
hero.note: No app to install. No commission on orders. Nothing you create is ever deleted.
hero.phoneDesktop: This is a real menu. Scroll it, search it, open a dish.
hero.phoneTouch: This is a real menu. Tap the phone to open it.
hero.phoneTitle: A live sample menu, shown inside a phone

steps.title: Add your menu
steps.text: Create categories and dishes, upload photos, set prices and opening hours.

steps.title: Print your QR codes
steps.text: One for the whole restaurant, or one for each table. Print-ready sheets are one click away.

steps.title: Guests scan and order
steps.text: The menu opens on any phone, with no app. Guests pick their dishes and send the order to your WhatsApp.

items.title: Arabic and English
items.text: Every page works right to left and left to right. Guests switch language with one tap.

items.title: A QR code for each table
items.text: Print-ready codes per table, so a WhatsApp order arrives with the table number.

items.title: Orders on WhatsApp
items.text: Guests build a selection and send it as a ready message. There is nothing to connect and no payment fee.

items.title: Several menus
items.text: Breakfast, lunch, drinks. Each menu and each category has its own opening hours.

items.title: Edits go live at once
items.text: Change a price, hide a dish that sold out, or mark today's special. Guests see it straight away.

items.title: Bulk tools
items.text: Change prices by a percentage, import and export CSV, duplicate dishes, undo the last change.

items.title: Your branding
items.text: Your logo, cover, colors and font. The menu keeps text readable whatever colors you pick.

items.title: Insights
items.text: See which dishes and categories your guests open most.

items.title: Works on a weak connection
items.text: Pages are small, the menu can be installed like an app, and it opens again without a connection.

pricing.title: Plans
pricing.intro: Every plan includes menus in Arabic and English and QR codes. You can change plan later.

items.q: Do my guests need to install an app?
items.a: No. The menu opens in the phone's browser after scanning the code, and they can add it to the home screen if they like.

items.q: Can the menu be in Arabic and English?
items.a: Yes. You write each name and description in both languages, and guests switch with one tap. Arabic pages are laid out right to left.
Guests pick dishes and tap send. A message with their selection opens in WhatsApp, addressed to your number, with the table number if they scanned a table code.

items.q: Can I have more than one menu?
items.a: Yes. Plans include several menus, each with its own opening hours, for example breakfast, lunch and drinks.

items.q: Do you take a commission on orders?
items.a: No. Orders go straight from your guest to your WhatsApp. You only pay for your plan.

items.q: What happens if I stop paying?
items.a: After your plan ends there is a grace period. Then the public menu goes offline and your admin becomes read only. Your data is never deleted, and paying again brings the menu back.

items.q: Can I change how the menu looks?
items.a: Yes. Add your logo and cover, choose colors and a font style, and pick how dishes are shown. The menu keeps text readable whatever colors you choose.

tour.step1Body: This dashboard is where you manage your categories and items. Add a category, then add items to it, every change appears on your public menu immediately.
tour.step2Body: Open any item to set sizes (variants), extras (add-ons), or mark it as today's special. Categories can also have their own time window, e.g. a Breakfast category shown only in the morning.
tour.step3Body: The QR codes page generates a printable code for your tables and a general one for your door or receipts, each one opens your public menu directly.
tour.step4Body: The Branding page is where you set your logo, cover image, primary color, and currency, your public menu picks these up automatically.
